description: Turn a scanned book (PDF or DjVu, up to 1,000 pages) into a clean, searchable PDF for e-readers: pages cropped to the text, straightened, sharp black and white, two-page spreads split, and searchable text added. Use it when the user wants to fix, clean up, OCR or convert a scan for a Kindle, Kobo, reMarkable or tablet. Give exactly one source: file (a file the user attached here), source_url (a public https link to the file) or upload_id (from create_upload_link, after the user uploaded). It returns a scan_id at once and the book converts in the background; then call get_scan_status until it is ready and give the user the download link.

file.description: A PDF or DjVu file the user attached in this chat.

download_url.description: Where the attached file can be downloaded.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Repeat it on a retry so the same book is not started twice.

keep_covers.description: Leave the front cover exactly as scanned.

language.description: The book's language for searchable text, as a Tesseract code; auto detects it.

note_margin.description: White space added to every page for writing notes: left, right or all round.

note_margin_cm.description: Width of the note margin in centimetres.

output.description: bw: sharp black and white, best on e-ink. grey: gentle greyscale.

source_url.description: A public https link to the PDF or DjVu file.

split_spreads.description: Split scans of two facing pages into single pages.

trim_margins.description: Crop each page to its text block. Covers and picture pages stay whole.

upload_id.description: The upload_id from create_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the file.

name: fix_scan
title: Fix a scanned book
